subject.title: Feature: Auto-leave WhatsApp groups not in allowlist + group-join webhook

question: Should explicit `channels.whatsapp.groups` entries authorize group membership, or should WhatsApp gain a separate group-JID membership policy, and should agents be denied direct leave authority in the initial implementation?
rationale: The dependency mechanics are available, but current config separates sender authorization from group identity, and the proposed message action crosses a destructive authorization boundary.

options.title: Configured groups authorize membership
options.body: Treat explicit group entries as approved memberships and add an opt-in deterministic self-add auto-leave policy with an owner audit notification.

options.title: Separate membership policy
options.body: Add a dedicated group-JID membership allowlist when configured group behavior should not imply approval to remain a member.

options.title: Agent-managed membership
options.body: Design a public join hook and leave action with target authorization, tool policy, and auditing before implementing departure.

recommendation.title: Configured groups authorize membership
recommendation.body: Treat explicit group entries as approved memberships and add an opt-in deterministic self-add auto-leave policy with an owner audit notification.
